name: Kota Kemuning - Petaling Jaya (KESAS E5 + LDP E11)
_note: Gates checked against OSM 2026-11-22: west = KESAS mainline just east of exit 506B Kota Kemuning; east = LDP mainline at exit 1108 Taman Megah, PJ. Each pos sits between the two carriageways, so cmd/analyze must snap per direction to a node whose road runs the right way (KESAS eastbound / LDP northbound for inbound). The bbox covers Kota Kemuning to TTDI plus the parallel routes (Federal Highway, NPE, Subang, Puchong) a driver could use instead.

gate_snap.source: Chosen 2026-11-23 on the real graph: snap only to motorway/trunk (not ramps or side streets). The west gate is ~360-400 m from the nearest KESAS junction nodes on both carriageways, with secondary roads nearer, so 500 m with the class filter. The east gate sits on the LDP exit-1108 diverge. See ARCHITECTURE §3.3 and decision 0003.

lane_drops.source: Chosen 2026-11-22 by checking the real graph: 400 m clears the widened plaza approaches on KESAS and LDP (11-15 booth lanes) without hiding the Sri Muda or exit-510 drops. See docs/decisions/0004-lane-drops-headline.md
